{{Quote|Was the speeder a gift from your father?''"<br />"''A bribe&mdash;but one I accepted.|[[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] and Palpatine|<ref name="SWDP" />}}
A '''prototype patrol-grade Flash''' was the personal [[Landspeeder/Legends|vehicle]] of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], a young [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Noble/Legends|aristocrat]] who ultimately became the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|A prototype patrol-grade Flash. I race competitively.''"<br />"''Do you win?''"<br />"''Why else would I bother racing?|Palpatine and Hego Damask|<ref name="SWDP" />}}
[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] prototype patrol-grade [[Seraph-class urban landspeeder|Flash]] was a triple-finned [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] with a pointed nose. It was painted in a bright color and powered by a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] that appeared strong enough to heft a [[Binary loadlifter/Legends|loadlifter]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]], according to [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]. The vehicle hovered at one meter above the ground surface, and was designed for speed and maneuverability. Around the year [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]], the landspeeder's rearview mirror was adorned with a pure [[Aurodium/Legends|aurodium]] [[Coin/Legends|coin]], a gift given to Palpatine from Plagueis after their first encounter in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].<ref name="SWDP" />

==History==
{{Quote|Maybe I'll become a professional racer.''"<br />"''The Naboo might expect more of the eldest son of House Palpatine.''"<br />"''I ignore the expectations of others.|Palpatine and Hego Damask|<ref name="SWDP" />}}
[[Cosinga Palpatine]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] descended from the [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic line]] of [[House Palpatine/Legends|House Palpatine]]&mdash;one of the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|royal families]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]&mdash;was the ultimate authority figure within his own household. His [[Palpatine's mother|wife]] was an obedient woman who accepted a position of subservience; his [[Palpatine's siblings|children]] were raised to be equally obedient&mdash;all except for one, the rebellious and wayward Palpatine. [[Reproduction/Legends|Born]] with a hidden, yet extraordinarily [[Force-sensitive/Legends|powerful connection]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Palpatine was an independent-minded youth who refused to allow the imposition of his father's will on himself. Despite the fact that Palpatine was a juvenile delinquent as a child, Cosinga used his [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|wealth]] and influence in many attempts to "buy" his firstborn son's loyalty.<ref name="SWDP" />

On one occasion, Cosinga purchased a prototype patrol-grade Flash and presented it as a gift for his son. Palpatine interpreted the gesture as a bribe, but ultimately accepted it due to his fascination with flying. After an incident that involved the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of two pedestrians, both inadvertently killed by Palpatine's landpeeder, Cosinga forbade the younger Palpatine from ever flying again. Later, Cosinga reconsidered his decision, allowing Palpatine to gain a winning streak in competitive [[Racing (disambiguation)|racing]], all the while developing a passion for the sport. For a time, he had aspirations to become a professional racer. Yet his ultimate ambition&mdash;the desire to rule with absolute power&mdash;exceeded his interest in racing.<ref name="SWDP" />

At the age of seventeen, Palpatine met a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] named Hego Damask, the [[magister]] of [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]]. Unknown to Palpatine, Damask was actually [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Plagueis, a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] dedicated to the destruction of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]],<ref name="SWDP" /> although Palpatine had in fact awaited the opportunity to join the Sith.<ref name="BOS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> After gaining the young [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo's]] confidence, Damask was given a tour of Theed's outskirts in Palpatine's prototype patrol-grade Flash. Palpatine's talents behind the controls of a landspeeder aside, Plagueis became far more interested with inducting him into the [[Order of the Sith Lords]] as an [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]].<ref name="SWDP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The prototype patrol-grade Flash landspeeder was created for the novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], written by [[James Luceno]] and published in [[2012]].<ref name="SWDP" />
